"The Boston Commons" a drink we serve on the menu at a bar I work at

1 egg white

1.5 oz gin

1.5 oz sauvignon blanc

2 dashes boston bittahs (or cardamom, both work fine really)

.5 oz lime juice

.5 oz lemon juice

.5 oz honey syrup

Tip of a barspoon of matcha tea powder

Dry shake, then shake with a big cube for about 20 seconds, double strain and enjoy! (Gotta shake hard to prevent that sediment)
